AT THE TABLE
    Made from a little clay & a big idea.
    Meet the ghosts ↗Rulebook ↓3D model ↓FIRST EDITION / 01
    THE QUICK RULES

    Rivals on the route.
    Partners at the core.

    Two humans, one screen, one d20. About 15–25 minutes.

    01

    Roll & move

    1–5 → 1 space · 6–10 → 2
    11–15 → 3 · 16–20 → 4
    A natural 20 adds 5 points. No exact roll needed at the core.

    02

    Pick your challenge

    Memorize a sense-themed set. Safe: 3 cards, earn the large number on your tile. Bold: 5 cards, earn that number +10, or lose 5 if wrong. Scores never fall below zero.

    03

    Repair together

    An unrestored beacon stops your move. Memorize a four-number code together. Player 1 enters its first two digits; Player 2 enters its last two. Both earn +10 for a repair.

    04

    Protect shared power

    A wrong repair costs 1 power. Retry the same beacon with a new code. At zero, the team loses. Before rolling, anyone can spend their turn to recharge 1 power, up to 3.

    05

    Bring both home

    Each player earns +10 on arrival. The first waits while the other keeps playing. Restore all five beacons and bring both players home to unlock the final scores.

    06

    Then compare scores

    Highest score wins the friendly rivalry; a tie is a shared crown. If the network loses power, neither player wins. Help each other on repairs; answer solo challenges on your own.

    All challenges work on screen. No tasting, smelling, hearing, touching objects, timers, or flashing effects are required. Take as long as you need.

    Your current game saves on this browser automatically. Starting again resets both scores and the network.
